acceptanceRules: A club with multiple 9-hole loops is one facility record unless each loop is independently selectable in the user's app.
A multi-course resort may have one facility with multiple selectable course layouts; preserve the distinction in layout metadata.
Never infer an exact course coordinate from a city centroid or a broad map viewport.
Each facility must map to exactly one configured weather subregion.
Only records with verified identity, current operating status, address, subregion and coordinates may be marked verified and enabled for live weather.
Candidate directory records can be visible as research candidates but must not be sent to weather providers while coordinates are pending.
Report source coverage counts separately from confirmed operating-course counts.
